description: This file is a shell script used in the OpenWrt project, specifically for platform upgrade procedures on the RT305X hardware platform. It defines functions for checking and performing firmware upgrades based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the firmware image; in this case, it always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process by calling the default upgrade function for the detected board.
